parsedVerdict.reasoning: This module passes. All four files handle one concern: application use cases for users. Each use case has an interface (CreateUserUseCase, ListUsersUseCase) and a service class that implements it (CreateUserService, ListUsersService), so the module follows one pattern throughout. Both services get UserRepository by injection and both map results through the shared toUserDto, so the DTO mapping lives in one place and isn't copied. Creating a user goes through User.create rather than building the object inline, so the domain invariants stay in the domain. The services don't skip their own ports: the ID comes from the IdGenerator port. The consumers depend on the interfaces: UserController injects the use-case interfaces, and only the composition root (userModule) imports the concrete services.
